scope: Two complete individual cards plus directly affected shield, damage, counter, blink and destruction rules. Development evidence; no aggregate/full-set acceptance.

sources.design_packet_qualification: Preserved pre-implementation full-source/design snapshot; subsequent implemented behavior is described here, including simultaneous damage-event selection and source-counter stat expression.
primary_rules: CR122.1c: one shield replacement and one prevention regardless of number of shields; counter is not a keyword ability
CR615.12/615.12a: additional counter removal still applies once for unpreventable damage
CR615.5 and CR616: prevention and affected-player replacement ordering

implementation.Captain_America: Printed3/2 first strike with one shield through ordinary entry-counter replacements. Live source-counter threshold gives its current controller and other current controlled Heroes hexproof. It does not grant itself hexproof. Actual and speculative worlds use the same counter and provider-availability query.
implementation.shield_counter: Append CounterKind::Shield after Finality without changing previous ordinals or eleven keyword kinds. Intrinsic prevention consumes exactly one counter per event even when damage cannot be prevented. Shared destruction helper preserves indestructibility first and applies to effect destruction, while sacrifice, exile and state-based zero-toughness/lethal destruction retain their rules.
implementation.simultaneous_damage: When simultaneous positive damage events compete for one shield, affected current controller chooses the event to process first. Own exact pending events, used-prevention rows and event-order flag; no invented printed ability index.
implementation.Mind_Stone: Real tap-for-white mana ability and instant5W tap harness activation, legal repeatedly. Harness is an exact-incarnation designation in owned cold state, survives control/copy/transform and clears on movement. It is not copied. The infinity own-end trigger is an actual granted template present only while harnessed and available. Optional other nonland controlled permanent is immediately blinked under its physical owner through ordinary entry continuations.
implementation.typed_stat_expression: SourceCounters(CounterKind) uses the exact live source in actual and funding worlds.
